title: Create the versioned v0.3 account store
acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Create the schema 3 SQLite account, credential, session, preference and retained-state model with immutable IDs. Define authoritative profile fields and private avatar storage. Refuse any older schema with a clear message.

**Verify** · Start a fresh v0.3 store, interrupt a write, and recover from a copied v0.3 backup. Reject a v0.1 or v0.2 store without changing it. Confirm IDs, roles and stored data survive a restart.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-055

**Queue** · Follows WI-055 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
